0.reason: the section's endpoint is a census record, not a guard; a repository test that every lock-taking flock goes through the cross-node lock belongs to the migration of the 20 remaining sites, which is a separate pending decision

findings.text: the set-equality check that keeps this census honest exists only as check_census.py under the run directory; nothing in the repository re-runs it, so a later commit that adds a lock-taking flock under reckon/ leaves every row here correct and the census silently incomplete with no failing test, and this is the whole of the durability this record scores.

the checker's _takes_lock special-cases the literal variable name flags as the only computed flag argument, so a flock call written fcntl.flock(fd, mode) or any other computed name is classified release-only and dropped from the site set without the check failing; no such call exists at 7d8ca3f4658 (an independent scan found exactly one computed argument, flags at reckon/crew/runs.py:493), so the census is correct today but the instrument would pass on a future miss.

call_sites.detail: a fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/ is read by the plan's landed record composer and by the resource discovery walk; no runtime path takes a lock because of it.

diff.detail: one commit adds one evidence fragment of 93 lines, with no source, test, plan or figure change.

done_when.detail: the done-when's set equality, stated count and both negative controls are asserted by check_census.py:74-94; census-check.log shows 43 sites / 43 rows and the controls log shows both arms with EXIT=1 and the missing/duplicate keys named.

goal.detail: the goal is a census of every lock-taking flock under reckon/ with one verdict each; docs/evidence/fragments/a-plan-state-lock-holds-on-every-node/every-flock-is-accounted-for.html:10-68 lists 43 rows whose data-site keys an independent AST walk of 7d8ca3f4658 reproduced exactly.

manifest.detail: the manifest states the checker command, the 43/43 result with 0 missing and 0 extra, the verdict split, both control failures and the two log paths.

write_paths.detail: the diff of 7d8ca3f4658ee37aebaeb0d9c7749394c1f4f85e..a8f1c7ba6b1340d5123a635772b6eec99f50751b touches only docs/evidence/fragments/a-plan-state-lock-holds-on-every-node/every-flock-is-accounted-for.html, which is the node's single declared write path.

justifications.durability: the only mechanism that catches a row dropped or a site uncensused is check_census.py:69, which lives under the run directory and is not committed, so no test in the repository reddens when a later commit adds a lock-taking flock under reckon/.
justifications.evidence: check_census.py:74-94 asserts exactly the done-when's set equality, count and duplicate rules, and census-check.log records 43 sites / 43 rows with VERDICT PASS and EXIT=0; I re-derived the same set independently (74 flock calls, 43 lock-taking, 31 release-only) and ran the two controls' logic against the fragment, so the gate is confirmed to measure what the done-when asks.
justifications.fit: docs/evidence/fragments/a-plan-state-lock-holds-on-every-node/every-flock-is-accounted-for.html:10-68 follows the sibling fragment head, meta and id-per-element shape, uses the plan's own three-verdict vocabulary, and carries no plan label in a name a reader would parse as code.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/a-plan-state-lock-holds-on-every-node/every-flock-is-accounted-for.html:10 names 43 lock-taking fcntl.flock calls at 7d8ca3f4658 and rows 1-43 at :25-68 give each a file:line, the object it guards, its cross-node reachability and exactly one verdict, which an independent AST walk of that commit reproduced as exactly 43 keys with none missing and none extra.
justifications.reuse: the landed change adds no definition; I searched docs/ for an existing flock inventory, scripts/census/ for a prior census utility, and the repo's AST walkers (reckon/clones.py, reckon/interface_counts.py) for the same capability and found no owner this fragment forks.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 7d8ca3f4658ee37aebaeb0d9c7749394c1f4f85e..a8f1c7ba6b1340d5123a635772b6eec99f50751b changes only docs/evidence/fragments/a-plan-state-lock-holds-on-every-node/every-flock-is-accounted-for.html, the one declared write path, and adds no source, test or plan edit.
